title: "Why did you decide that?" Replaying a decision
story: ShopBot's INR 1,250 payment is allowed. Later, someone asks why. The Guard re-runs the Decision from its Audit record, on the exact Policy pack it was made with, and checks the answer matches byte for byte.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The wallet app can replay the Decision from its Audit record and compare the answer.

what_to_notice: Replay uses the recorded inputs and the recorded Policy pack, so today's limits and clock can't change the answer. The Guard inspector shows every rule that ran, and its Verify / Replay button runs this check again.
